## Checklist

- [ ] `scripts/check-lessons.sh` passes
- [ ] Kit changes: an update note in `updates/` and a `changelog.d/<slug>.md` fragment, not a CHANGELOG.md edit (`scripts/check-updates.sh --since origin/main` passes)
- [ ] Showcase evidence summary: the file is exactly the script's output, one PR for it alone, and for an anonymous share the PR text says nothing about what the project is
- [ ] Lessons and kit changes: no project, company, person, repo, URL, hostname or id in the text
- [ ] One rule per lesson; no duplicate of an existing lesson
